thread:
ida: quick idea for playground run history: show a "glance" row with a one-line human summary + tiny tool breadcrumb. expand to see details.

leo: i like that. keeps the list scannable. breadcrumb example: 'Extract OCR  Translate(1)  APICall' (low-contrast).

sam: small note: nested tool calls should show a depth indicator like '> x2' and a single-line preview 'contains nested calls' rather than dumping JSON. expand shows a collapsible tree.

mike: accessibility nits: 1) make glance row one tab stop 2) expand receives focus and announce 'Run expanded, 3 tool calls' via aria-live 3) visible focus ring for keyboard.

ida: stream handling: show progressive summary for stream:true (eg 'translating... partial') with spinner; final state replaces with final summary snapshot.

leo: copy tweak: hide "tokens" metric by default behind a metrics chevron; use friendlier wording like 'units used' when shown.

ux-bot: telemetry suggestions: playground.run.open_glance, playground.run.inline_label_edit, playground.run.stream_snapshot. include run_id and user_id.

ida: i'll mock compact + stacked variants and include a long nested tool output so eng can test collapse heuristics. tagging @leo @mike for review. :sparkles:
